rows.headline: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 features price cuts on Samsung Galaxy S25 and Z Fold series
rows.hook: Deep discounts on flagship Samsung smartphones
rows.summary: Amazon has announced promotional pricing for Samsung's flagship Galaxy S25 Ultra and Z Fold 7 models as part of its Great Indian Festival 2026 sale. These discounts are aimed at driving consumer electronics volume during the peak festive shopping season. Retail investors tracking consumer discretionary spending may view this as a key indicator of festive demand trends for premium electronics in India.
rows.why_it_matters: Signals consumer appetite for premium electronics during the festive season.
rows.winners_losers: Amazon and Samsung gain / Competitors face pressure

rows.headline: Vertiv executive discusses power challenges for AI data centres
rows.hook: AI infrastructure faces critical power supply constraints
rows.summary: Greg Funk of Vertiv highlights that the rapid expansion of AI data centres is straining existing power grids and infrastructure. The surge in energy demand requires a fundamental rethink of how data centres are powered and cooled. This shift impacts companies involved in power management, cooling solutions, and electrical infrastructure. Indian retail investors should note the growing demand for power-related industrial equipment as AI adoption accelerates.
rows.why_it_matters: Rising power demand boosts prospects for electrical and cooling equipment manufacturers.
rows.winners_losers: Power infrastructure firms gain / Data centres face costs

rows.headline: PNB Gilts appoints Amit Kumar Srivastava as Non-Executive Chairman
rows.hook: Leadership change at state-backed primary dealer
rows.summary: PNB Gilts Ltd has announced the appointment of Amit Kumar Srivastava as a Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director, as well as the Chairman of the company. The appointment is effective from October 9, 2026. PNB Gilts operates as a primary dealer in government securities in India. Retail investors in banking and financial stocks should note changes in board-level leadership for governance tracking.
rows.why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial impact.
